profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software developer with extensive experience designing, developing and supporting personal computer software. Design/development: system level, communications protocols, network communications, graphical/web user interface, computer telephony, testing, licensing, software protection. Support: system installation, technical/sales/marketing support, working with management/public.

Specialties: Product development, C#, C++, .NET, WPF, graphical and web user interfaces (CSS, JavaScript), device interfacing, telecommunications, messaging, telephony, audio production, graphic design, entertainment automation.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Owner
positions.description: Created own software products, DAZL® and DAZL Player, multimedia show automation software (Windows, .NET, WPF, MEF, WAF, MVVM, Entity Framework, SQL, DirectX, XAudio2, MIDI, DMX, sACN, game I/O, GPIO, servo/motor control). Created company and website for on-line sale and support of products.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description: Software consultant while living in Asia. Created cross-platform product (HotelMGR) used to manage hotel maintenance workflows (ad hoc/preventative maintenance) using various technologies (Ruby, Rails, C++, Text-to-speech, Asterisk IP PBX).

company.name: Innovation Technologies Worldwide, a div. of TigerTMS

positions.title: Director Of Software Development
positions.description: Worked for leader in hospitality messaging/automated guest services market. Created industry-leading application (InnLine 2020), many hospitality interfaces (PBX, PMS), test/support tools. (DOS, Windows, Delphi, C, C++, C#, .NET, Dialogic). Helped grow company from two-man operation to multi-million-dollar industry leader. Managed Development throughout growth of company, acquisition by Swiss company, and subsequent transition back to private ownership. (Later acquired by TigerTMS, then by Mitel.)

company.name: Innovation Technologies Worldwide, a div. of TigerTMS

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description: Software consultant while taking graduate-level Computer Science and foreign language studies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked for industry-leader in telephone answering service market. Developed interfaces, drivers, APIs, test software for proprietary telephony hardware (XDS), telephony applications (messaging, radio contest). Several operating systems (DOS, OS/2, Windows NT, AMX RTOS) and languages (assembly, C, C++) were used.
